title: Accounts Payable: Accounting and Management
overview: Accounts Payable (AP) is more than just processing checks and maintaining records—it plays a critical role in the financial health of an organization. Effective AP management requires a solid understanding of its foundational components, such as customer service, vendor management, check requests, and Purchase Orders (POs).

This course provides a comprehensive exploration of AP processes, including invoice handling, error prevention, audit preparation, and the integration of technology. Participants will also learn best practices to transform their AP department into a valuable business partner within their organization.
audience: This course is ideal for accounts payable managers, staff, clerks, and specialists seeking career advancement. It is also beneficial for professionals in accounting, finance, purchasing, and procurement who interact closely with accounts payable functions.
methodology: The course combines theoretical insights with practical applications, including the use of Microsoft Excel for managing accounts payable. Participants will engage in role-playing exercises and deliver presentations to reinforce their understanding of key concepts.
competencies: Understanding the role and impact of accounts payable
Preparing and analyzing accounts payable aging reports
Applying best practices in AP management
Using Excel for data analysis and reporting
objectivesIntro: By the end of the course, participants will be able to:
objectives: Understand the role of accounts payable within an organization.
Apply accounting principles to manage accounts payable effectively.
Take a leadership role in optimizing AP operations.
Assess and improve AP processes using best practices.
Enhance staff efficiency and productivity by addressing key challenges.
Leverage Excel tools and techniques to manage and monitor AP performance.
